notes: GAAP. Governmental lines from Exhibit E Total Governmental Funds column (trimmed p6; fund columns on p5). Business-type lines from Exhibit H Totals column (p10), net position roll-forward; cash-flow statement p11. Taxes line (874,564) split using fund schedules: property tax 328,511 (General) + 42,269 (Recreation), motor vehicle tax 42,088, sales tax 58,730+120,144+60,000+201,949; remaining 20,873 is the Debt Service Fund property tax (Sched 24, p34, added by the v7 re-trim), now recorded as property tax. Exhibit E Total column lines sum to 2,664,674 but printed total revenues is 2,665,071; the 397 difference equals Keno lottery revenue (p32), added as a separate keno/lottery receipt so the roll-forward ties. Debt principal 179,859 and interest 30,092 are printed below total expenditures as other financing uses; recorded as disbursements with outside_printed_total. Transfers in and out both 699,362 (p6); transfers in found in trimmed schedules total 637,732, the other 61,630 matches the Fire Truck Sinking outflow and is the Debt Service Fund's transfer in (Sched 24, p34). Ending cash computed as cash in bank, cash on hand, county treasurer cash, CDs and restricted cash (p4). Balance sheet is the government-wide Statement of Net Position Totals 2025 column (p1); due from/due to other funds 1,636,775 appear on both sides as printed. Detail: General Fund expenditures use Sched 2A (more detailed) instead of Sched 2 object groups; Street uses Sched 4A; revenue from Sched 2 and 4. Zero-actual/zero-budget lines omitted; lines with zero actual but budget shown. Transfers inside fund schedules are 'other financing' signed; debt payments printed under Other financing sources (uses) below Total expenditures (Street p15, Recreation p22, Summer Rec p30) are expenditure lines (debt service principal/interest) with outside_printed_total, matching the top level. Business-type fund schedules by department are not in the trimmed PDF; Electric, Water and Sewer detail is one receipts and one disbursements line each from the budgetary cash-basis Sched 29 (p36), with review notes on interfund due-to/due-from flows (Sched 28, p35). Debt Service Fund detail from Sched 24 (p34); its Sched 29 line not recorded (double counting). Sched 8 (pp17-18, General Fund sub-funds combining statement) duplicates Scheds 9-20 and is not recorded in detail; Sched 28 (p35) reconciles accrual to cash basis and is not recorded. Trimmed p33 is the continuation of the combining schedule (Grant Project and Totals columns). Pages renumbered after the v7 re-trim (old trimmed pp17-31 are now pp19-33). Read pages 1-36 of 36
